# Breadberry Co. by Adhira Enterprises

> Premium wholesale supplier of IQF frozen berries, fruit purees, imported fresh produce, bakery & Japanese staples, and frozen seafood for 5-star hotels, fine-dining restaurants, confectioneries, and cafés across Mumbai and India.

## Core Information
- **Brand Name**: Breadberry Co.
- **Parent Company**: Adhira Enterprises (also searched as Adira Enterprises)
- **Headquarters**: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- **Client Base**: Over 1,000 professional kitchens, hotels, bakeries, and QSRs served since 2018
- **Primary Business**: B2B Wholesale Foodservice Importer & Cold-Chain Distributor
- **Contact**: +91 98205 12345 | enquiry@breadberry.co.in | https://breadberry.co.in

## Wholesale Catalogue Categories
1. **IQF Frozen Berries**: Whole, individually quick-frozen strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, blackberries, cranberries, and mix berries stored at −18 °C.
2. **Fruit Purees**: High-purity 100% fruit purees for patisserie, gelaterias, and beverage bases (Strawberry, Blueberry, Raspberry, Passionfruit, Acai).
3. **Fresh Produce**: Chilled farm-fresh avocados (Hass), asparagus (Peruvian/Thai), fresh berries, heirloom tomatoes, and specialty greens held at 2–6 °C.
4. **Bakery & Japanese Staples**: Nori, bao buns, fillo & kataifi pastry sheets (Antoniou), gyoza skins, panko, edamame, and Asian condiments.
5. **Frozen Seafood**: Cold-smoked & raw Atlantic salmon fillets, hamachi, saku tuna blocks, whole black cod, Chilean seabass, and tobikko roe.

## Quality & Distribution Guarantees
- **Unbroken Cold Chain**: Dedicated walk-in freezers and temperature-controlled logistics from warehouse to kitchen door.
- **Batch Documentation**: HACCP, FSSAI, and batch certification provided per dispatch on request.
- **Flexible Ordering**: Pack sizes from 1 kg trial packs to full multi-pallet container shipments.
